# Maintain technical terms

Use this skill to add or review domain-specific technical nouns and verbs.
ASD-STE100 Issue 9 permits technical terms from a subject field.
The approved dictionary and project glossary have different purposes.

## Procedure

1. Search the shared and domain glossaries for the concept.
2. Identify the subject field and the necessary meaning.
3. Check whether an approved Issue 9 word already gives that meaning.
4. If the dictionary word is not suitable, select a valid technical noun or verb.
5. Give the concept a stable ID and one preferred term.
6. Write one short definition.
7. Record a permitted alias only when its meaning is clear.
8. Add relations only when there is a verified need for them.
9. Keep general terms in the independent registry.
10. Keep domain terms in the relevant domain repository.
11. Run the concept validator and review the technical meaning.
12. Record the source, owner, decision, and version.

## Restrictions

Do not put the protected ASD-STE100 dictionary in the registry.
Do not call a project term an approved ASD dictionary word.
Do not make a consumer project the owner of the shared terminology.
A full OWL ontology needs a separate decision and a verified query use case.
